title: Expedia third-party vendor breach, Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Expedia, Skift, Cybernews, The Seattle Times or any other company, news outlet, government agency, or anyone else named.
size_basis: Unconfirmed. A group claims about a billion records; roughly 500MB has been posted, per Cybernews. Expedia has not said what was exposed.
who_is_affected: Not yet clear. A posted dataset is said to hold traveler emails, bookings and loyalty details. Expedia has not confirmed that. Watch for fake booking emails.

known.text: Expedia confirmed attackers got in through a compromised third-party data platform provider.

not_known.text: Whether the billion-record claim is true.
Whether customer data was taken, and whose.
Which vendor, and how the attacker got in.
